errors.text_span: “华山”、“嘉兴”、“临安”和“江南”的柱状条高度相近，均在120至140次之间
errors.evidence: The description states that the bars for '华山' (Huashan), '嘉兴' (Jiaxing), '临安' (Lin'an), and '江南' (Jiangnan) are all between 120 and 140. However, only '华山' (~130) falls in this range. The other values are approximately '嘉兴' (~110), '临安' (~100), and '江南' (~95), which are all below 120.
